final: WITH patient_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM patient_counts), ratios AS (SELECT p.ID, p.record_count, CAST(p.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS ratio FROM patient_counts AS p JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.ID, r.record_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - m.average_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r JOIN mean_ratio AS m ON m.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
